projects.title: Scheduling and Administration Web Panel
projects.description: White-label platform for online booking, schedules, services, staff, customers and day-to-day operations in one panel.

details.description: A white-label online booking platform that connects the customer journey with the team’s daily operation in one flow. Customers can choose a service or professional, check real availability, select a date and time, sign in or create an account, review their information and confirm the booking. On the administrative side, teams manage branches, professionals, services, customers, schedules, availability exceptions, appointment statuses and visual identity while monitoring operational indicators and upcoming appointments from the dashboard.
features: Guided public booking with service or professional selection, calendar, available time slots and a final review before confirmation
Customer area for viewing bookings and cancelling future appointments
Operational dashboard with today’s agenda, pending items, upcoming appointments and status distribution
Service management with duration, price and relationships to branches and professionals
Professional schedules with weekly blocks, intervals, unavailable periods and extra availability
Branch, staff and customer management with role-based administrative permissions
Per-company white-label identity with logo, favicon, color palette and public booking copy

technicalSpecs.label: Operational model

technicalSpecs.value: Brand asset pipeline handles logo and favicon processing, WebP conversion and versioned asset URLs for consistent white-label updates.

projects.title: XtremeFut — futsal training with Ferrão
projects.description: Physical preparation and futsal training app with professionally authored content, guided videos and recommendations tailored to the athlete profile.

details.description: XtremeFut turns professional training guidance into an organized mobile experience. Built in partnership with futsal player Ferrão, the app combines workout sequences and exercises written by professionals, video demonstrations, rest intervals, planned rest days and recommendations aligned with the user's profile. Age range, height and weight help suggest a level and goal, while athletes can explore the catalog, follow day-by-day routines, review exercises and keep relevant content close at hand.
features: Training plans and exercises structured from content authored by sports professionals
Partnership with Ferrão as the athlete at the center of the product proposition
Level and goal recommendations based on age, height, weight and derived profile indicators
Day-by-day sequences including planned rest days whenever the routine requires them
Exercises with video, sets, repetitions, rest intervals and execution guidance
Catalog browsing by level, goal, equipment and muscle group
Search, favorites and profile features to keep relevant routines easy to find
Authentication, account recovery, preferences and Portuguese, English, Spanish and Arabic support

projects.title: Accessibility Plugin — web accessibility SDK
projects.description: Pluggable SDK that adds reading, contrast, focus, speech and visual personalization tools to existing websites and systems without rebuilding the host application.

details.description: Accessibility Plugin adds a personalization layer to existing digital products. Users can start from ready-made profiles or combine text, contrast, color, cursor, reading focus, reduced-motion and text-to-speech settings according to their needs. The interface works on desktop and mobile, preserves preferences between sessions and can adopt the host brand without interfering with the surrounding layout.
features: Presets for ADHD, autism, low vision, color blindness and visual impairment
Text scaling, dyslexia-friendly font, spacing controls and text-case transformation
Contrast, saturation, grayscale and color adjustments for different visual needs
Large cursors, magnification and visual tracking aids
Reading guide and reading mask to reduce distraction and keep focus on the current region
Text-to-speech by mouse or touch with visual highlighting and playback controls
Reduced motion and visual stimulation with full restoration of the original page state
Persistent preferences, Portuguese/English/Spanish UI and white-label customization

technicalSpecs.label: Modular architecture
technicalSpecs.value: A UI-independent core, feature registry and diff-based updates reapply only preference groups that actually changed.

technicalSpecs.label: UI isolation
technicalSpecs.value: The widget runs inside Shadow DOM to prevent CSS and JavaScript collisions with the host product while keeping accessibility effects outside the encapsulated UI.

technicalSpecs.label: Reversible lifecycle
technicalSpecs.value: Each feature implements update, reset and dispose; original styles and attributes are preserved so the SDK can be disabled or destroyed cleanly.

technicalSpecs.label: Dynamic DOM
technicalSpecs.value: MutationObserver tracks content inserted after load, with support for Document, registered open ShadowRoots and same-origin iframes.

technicalSpecs.label: Text-to-speech
technicalSpecs.value: An isolated SpeechEngine uses native browser APIs, handles selection, element, section and page scopes and maintains highlighting on desktop and touch.

technicalSpecs.label: Persistent state
technicalSpecs.value: Preferences use a versioned schema with migrations so the storage format can evolve without losing saved settings.

technicalSpecs.label: Licensing
technicalSpecs.value: A provider layer supports signed local licenses, remote validation or custom implementations with host, validity and entitlement rules.

technicalSpecs.label: Cryptography
technicalSpecs.value: Web Crypto API verifies ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signatures for licensed distribution scenarios.

technicalSpecs.label: Quality
technicalSpecs.value: The suite covers state, migrations, keyboard use, TTS, reversibility, dynamic DOM, Shadow DOM, iframe behavior and reset/destroy flows.

technicalSpecs.label: Lean runtime
technicalSpecs.value: The production core has no framework dependency at runtime, reducing payload size and integration conflicts.

projects.title: Unity 3D Multiplayer Truco
projects.description: 3D truco game with offline bot matches and online multiplayer for up to four players, with desktop and mobile controls.

details.description: A 3D card game set around a bar table, with offline matches against bots and online matches for up to four players. The experience synchronizes card dealing, turns, played cards, score and truco decisions among participants while keeping each player tied to their own seat and hand. World-space controls are designed for mouse and touch, allowing players to switch between table and hand views and perform actions directly inside the 3D environment.
features: Offline matches against bots without depending on other players
Online rooms for up to four players with the match starting when the table is complete
Assigned seats and avatars for consistent player position and identification throughout the match
Synchronized dealing, turns, played cards, vira, manilha, score and truco decisions
World-space controls to play cards, answer actions and switch between table and hand views
Mouse and touch interaction with raycast priority for the local hand’s relevant elements
Build structure prepared for desktop and mobile platforms

projects.title: Radar Público · Public Tender Search & Intelligence
projects.description: Web platform for finding and tracking Brazilian public tenders with contextual search, advanced filters, company-based recommendations, alerts, and direct access to official sources and documents.

details.description: Radar Público centralizes real opportunities published by official Brazilian government sources and turns tender discovery into a simpler workflow for companies and professionals who do not want to search portal by portal. Search accepts everyday terms and combines words, context, and related topics to surface more useful opportunities — for example, a query for “educational games” can consider pedagogical games, learning software, educational web platforms, and devices used in teaching without mixing in unrelated results. Public search works without an account. After creating an account and configuring the company, users can save filters, receive alerts about new opportunities, track changes, organize tenders in a pipeline, and get an explainable fit indication based on criteria such as capabilities, region, value range, and requirements. Each opportunity brings together identifiers, agency, status, values, dates, items, documents, and links back to the official systems, keeping the government source as the reference.
features: Public search without an account, covering subject, agency, items, location, values, dates, and other tender information
Contextual search that expands related concepts and combines intent groups to improve relevance instead of relying only on literal keyword matches
Advanced filters with multi-selection for state, city, agency, procurement method, status, and source, plus value ranges and date periods
Relevance-ranked results with official identifiers, agency, location, estimated value, deadlines, procurement method, and status
Detailed opportunity view with procurement number, process, subject, items, values, dates, responsible unit, documents, and change history when available
Direct links to PNCP, the source procurement system, and electronic process when those official URLs are provided
Company profile with capabilities, target regions, value range, and requirements used to generate recommendations and an explainable fit score
Saved searches with alerts when new matching procurements appear or tracked opportunities receive relevant changes
Commercial tracking with pipeline stages, owners, notes, tasks, decisions, and planned bid value to move from discovery to an internal process
Responsive desktop and mobile experience covering search, filters, registration, notifications, tracking, and company management

technicalSpecs.label: Architecture
technicalSpecs.value: Modular monolith built with ASP.NET Core / .NET 10. Backend, authentication, background services, and API run in the same host, while React, TypeScript, and Vite build the interface served as static assets by ASP.NET Core.

technicalSpecs.label: Official data sources
technicalSpecs.value: Ingestion uses public PNCP and Compras.gov.br integrations behind a source abstraction, keeping controllers and UI independent from external payload formats and leaving room for additional government portals.

technicalSpecs.label: Ingestion pipeline
technicalSpecs.value: Procurements are discovered, preserved first as raw JSONB payloads, and then normalized into agencies, opportunities, items, documents, and changes. Persistent queues and HostedServices make incremental synchronization resumable.

technicalSpecs.label: Search and relevance
technicalSpecs.value: PostgreSQL runs Portuguese Full Text Search together with pg_trgm, unaccent, and dedicated indexes. A deterministic intent layer expands contexts and combines term groups to improve precision and recall without reducing search to substring matching.

technicalSpecs.label: Recommendations
technicalSpecs.value: Company fit is calculated with auditable rules over capabilities, regions, value range, requirements, and other profile signals. The score is displayed together with positive and negative reasons that contributed to it.

technicalSpecs.label: Documents
technicalSpecs.value: Official metadata and URLs stay linked to the procurement. When files are processed locally, the system calculates SHA-256, keeps immutable checksum-based versions, extracts text from digital PDFs with PdfPig, and flags documents that require OCR.

technicalSpecs.label: Change detection
technicalSpecs.value: Checksums and normalized fields are used to identify deadline, value, status, payload, and document changes, keeping a history and feeding notifications for tracked opportunities.

technicalSpecs.label: Accounts and authorization
technicalSpecs.value: Users and companies are stored in Radar Público's own PostgreSQL database. Authentication uses same-origin cookies and local password hashes, with owner, analyst, and viewer roles scoped to an organization.

technicalSpecs.label: Automation
technicalSpecs.value: HostedServices handle open-proposal refreshes, incremental synchronization, document processing, deadline alerts, and saved-search reevaluation without requiring Redis, message brokers, or paid services.

technicalSpecs.label: Runtime
technicalSpecs.value: Docker Compose starts the application and PostgreSQL in a reproducible flow. The frontend is compiled during build, so the final runtime does not require a separate Node server.

projects.title: SupportCircle · Neurodivergence & Support Network
projects.description: Web platform and mobile app for neurodivergent people and their support networks, bringing reliable information, support profiles, passports, records, routines and communication into one person-centered space.

details.description: SupportCircle was created to support neurodivergent people and help family members, friends, educators, caregivers and professionals better understand individual needs, preferences, sensitivities, communication styles and helpful strategies. The platform starts with the person — not the diagnosis — and turns everyday information into something clear, organized and shared only with authorized people. Its library brings together more than 200 resources on neurodivergence, accessibility, education, work, health, autonomy, relationships and daily life, built from institutional and government sources, legislation, specialist organizations and scientific publications, with references available for consultation. Support Profiles, Passports, daily records, routines and conversations help the support network apply that knowledge in real situations. In the mobile app, selected resources can be downloaded and read without an internet connection. The goal is to bring reliable information closer to practical, respectful support without diagnosing, prescribing or replacing professional care.
features: Support circles built around the neurodivergent person, with access defined individually for family, friends, education staff, caregivers and professionals
Support Profile and Passport for communication preferences, sensitivities, needs and helpful strategies, with explicit control over what is shared
Daily records for documenting situations, context, strategies and outcomes without turning observations into diagnoses or automatic causal claims
Routines and day-specific changes for communicating sequences, schedules, transitions and predictable reference points
Library with more than 200 resources, 73 topics and 78 unique sources covering neurodivergence, accessibility, education, health, work, autonomy and everyday life
Visible references on each resource, combining institutional sources, public agencies, legislation, specialist organizations and scientific publications
Natural-language search with synonyms, related terms, subject filters and editorial rules for situations that require a higher level of attention
Context-based conversations — General, Family, School and Professionals — so information can be shared without collapsing every relationship into one channel
Mobile app with selective downloads, offline library access, locally available Passports and routines, and synchronization when connectivity returns
Granular permissions, consent, invitations and access revocation so information is shared only with the people who are meant to see it

technicalSpecs.label: Architecture
technicalSpecs.value: Laravel centralizes domain, web and a versioned API in a single application. Blade, Livewire and Alpine.js compose the web UI without a separate frontend, while the Expo app consumes /api/v1.

technicalSpecs.label: Person-centered model
technicalSpecs.value: User represents who accesses the system and Person represents who receives support. A person can self-manage, be managed by a guardian, exist without login credentials and own an independent circle.

technicalSpecs.label: Authorization
technicalSpecs.value: Relationship and permission are independent. Policies and granular permissions govern profile access, records, routines, documents, conversation channels and circle administration without granting full access from a social role alone.

technicalSpecs.label: Knowledge and search
technicalSpecs.value: Editorial content is stored in MySQL and searched through FULLTEXT, aliases, synonyms, topics, audience and attention level. Risk handling uses deterministic editorial rules rather than generative classification.

technicalSpecs.label: Mobile offline layer
technicalSpecs.value: SQLite stores only selected data: downloaded materials, synchronized person lists, Passport content, routines and drafts. Downloads are isolated per user and remain searchable without connectivity.

technicalSpecs.label: Synchronization
technicalSpecs.value: TanStack Query coordinates remote state and device connectivity. When the connection returns, the app revalidates the session, authorized people and downloaded materials while updating local cache without treating SQLite as a replica of the main database.

technicalSpecs.label: Realtime
technicalSpecs.value: Laravel Reverb delivers messages and contextual events to authorized channels. Chat can reference records and knowledge materials while authorization remains enforced on the backend.

technicalSpecs.label: Privacy and traceability
technicalSpecs.value: Consents, invitations, revocations, permission changes, exports and relevant administrative actions are audited without writing raw sensitive content to application logs.

technicalSpecs.label: Local runtime
technicalSpecs.value: Docker Compose starts MySQL, migrations, initial data, the application, queue worker and Reverb with healthchecks and non-standard host ports for a reproducible one-command environment.

technicalSpecs.label: Experience
technicalSpecs.value: Web and mobile share visual language, minimalist navigation, readable typography, responsive behavior and low-stimulation presentation while technical synchronization controls stay out of the main user path.

projects.title: MediaForge — media processing and engineering
projects.description: Web suite for image optimization, background removal, metadata cleaning, visual comparison, video processing, file security, colors and asset generation.

details.description: MediaForge brings together tasks that would normally require several separate tools. It can optimize images, remove backgrounds, clean privacy metadata, compare visual versions, extract palettes, process video, protect files, calculate hashes, generate passwords, build asset packs and work with colors and gradients. The product prioritizes local processing and uses server-side routes only when they improve compatibility or output quality.
features: JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF optimization and conversion with quality and dimension controls
Tolerance-based background removal with edge smoothing and transparent export
EXIF, GPS, XMP and IPTC inspection and cleaning, including HEIC/HEIF support
Image comparison with normalized-content and exact-layout modes plus a visual diff map
Dominant palette extraction and color contrast, harmony and conversion tools
Video compression, conversion, trimming, audio extraction and frame capture
File encryption, SHA-256/SHA-512 hashes and password generation/analysis
Asset-pack generation for favicon, PWA, Android and iOS plus a gradient builder
Local operation history and responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layouts

technicalSpecs.label: Frontend
technicalSpecs.value: Next.js 15, React 19 and TypeScript structure the studio, history and independent workflows for each tool.

technicalSpecs.label: Hybrid image pipeline
technicalSpecs.value: Canvas handles local operations while a Node route with Sharp/libvips covers server-side autorotation, resizing and encoding when needed.

technicalSpecs.label: Background removal
technicalSpecs.value: A flood-fill algorithm starts from image edges, estimates the background color, applies RGB tolerance and creates alpha falloff around object boundaries without an external service.

technicalSpecs.label: Privacy
technicalSpecs.value: Inspection covers EXIF/TIFF/GPS/XMP/IPTC metadata; files can be reconstructed without those blocks and HEIC/HEIF is decoded locally before sanitization.

technicalSpecs.label: Image Diff

projects.title: Pocket Links — managed links, QR Codes and analytics
projects.description: Mobile app and web platform for managed short links, custom aliases, QR Codes, access analytics and synchronization across unstable connections.

details.description: Pocket Links turns a short address into a resource that remains manageable after it has been shared. Users can create links with custom aliases, QR Codes, tags, UTM parameters and configurable expiration, then change the destination without changing the published address, disable or reactivate it and review access activity. The mobile app works with the web/API platform, keeps local state and maintains a synchronization queue when connectivity becomes unstable.
features: Persistent short links with generated codes or custom aliases and availability checks
QR Code tied to the managed address for digital sharing or printed material
Destination editing without changing the distributed link, plus enable, disable and delete actions
Expiration using presets or a custom number of days
Access analytics with totals, recent activity and device, browser and origin data when available
Tags, favorites, search and filters for larger link collections
UTM builder for campaigns without exposing long tracking URLs
Offline queue, automatic/manual synchronization and clear pending-operation feedback
Responsive web UI and mobile app sharing the same API and database

technicalSpecs.label: Quality

projects.title: Realtime Messaging · Real-Time Messaging Platform
projects.description: Real-time messaging platform with DMs, channels, presence, reconnect replay and full infrastructure observability.

details.description: A real-time messaging platform for direct conversations and channels with invitations, presence, typing indicators, persistent unread state, blocking, image attachments and history. The experience is built to remain reliable across connection drops: clients reconnect and recover missing messages from persisted history while multiple gateways distribute real-time connections. End-to-end telemetry also provides visibility into connections, message volume, replay, latency and infrastructure behavior.
features: Direct conversations and channels with invitations and membership control
Online presence, typing indicators and persistent read/unread state
User blocking and image attachments with file validation
Reconnection with replay of missing messages from the persisted sequence
Idempotent message identifiers to reduce duplicates during retries
Multiple gateways for distributing HTTP and WebSocket connections
Metrics, traces and dashboards for availability, latency and message-flow visibility

technicalSpecs.label: Distributed topology
technicalSpecs.value: Nginx balances HTTP and WebSocket traffic across multiple ASP.NET Core gateways, allowing more than one real-time service instance to run concurrently.

technicalSpecs.label: Durable path
technicalSpecs.value: Persistent messages are written to PostgreSQL together with a transactional outbox and then published to NATS JetStream, reducing divergence risk between the database and event bus.

technicalSpecs.label: Ephemeral events
technicalSpecs.value: Core NATS handles fan-out for signals that do not need persistence, such as presence and typing, keeping the ephemeral path separate from durable history.

technicalSpecs.label: Distributed presence
technicalSpecs.value: Redis maintains presence state shared across gateways so separate connections observe a consistent view of online users.

technicalSpecs.label: WebSocket protocol
technicalSpecs.value: The flow supports subscribe/resume, heartbeat, delivery acknowledgements, mark-read, typing and paged replay after a known sequence, plus payload limits and backpressure handling.

technicalSpecs.label: Consistency
technicalSpecs.value: Idempotent clientMessageId values, persisted sequence numbers and replay allow sessions to resume without duplicating accepted messages and recover gaps after reconnect.

technicalSpecs.label: Security
technicalSpecs.value: HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens, PBKDF2-SHA512 password derivation, constant-time comparisons, per-connection rate limiting and MIME plus binary-signature validation for attachments.

technicalSpecs.label: Observability
technicalSpecs.value: OpenTelemetry instruments the application; Prometheus collects metrics; Grafana exposes operational dashboards and Jaeger supports distributed-trace investigation.

technicalSpecs.label: Quality and load
technicalSpecs.value: xUnit covers backend behavior while k6 runs functional and load scenarios across authentication, DMs, persistence, blocking, channels, invitations and WebSockets.

technicalSpecs.label: Delivery
technicalSpecs.value: Docker Compose assembles the full stack and GitHub Actions validates backend, frontend, containers, readiness and integrated scenarios before release.
